type_specific.note: New leaf data package with zero consumers — no build-chain propagation needed. register:sync-index is NOT required for data packages per CLAUDE.md libs/data/

issues: verifyAll() (store.ts:601-672) uses a buggy Promise.race + findIndex pattern — Promise.resolve(result) creates a new reference so findIndex always returns -1, causing pending array to never shrink. No test exercises this path currently, so tests pass. Should be fixed before production use.
handoff_notes: All blob-store source files are new (untracked). The package@adhd/sox-blob-store is a standalone data library with zero deps on other @adhd/* packages.
The pinned column and pin/unpin/isPinned API are fully implemented per SPEC.md §12 gap resolution #3.
The verifyAll method has a known Promise.race bug (see issues). No tests exercise it, so it doesn't block but should be addressed in a follow-up.

backlog_entries.description: verifyAll() uses Promise.race + findIndex with Promise.resolve(result) which never matches the original promise. Pending promises never drain. Marked for fix.
